catalogue_metadata.primary_source: Secondary Electronics Resale Market Index & E-Waste Component Scrap Survey (Illustrative Demonstration Data)
catalogue_metadata.general_disclaimer: All estimates are illustrative indicators based on visual form factor. Real resale pricing is subject to pin integrity, functional bench testing, silicon verification, and current industrial procurement demand.

generic_ic.name: Generic SMD / DIP IC
generic_ic.condition_assumptions: Unsolderable package, pins straight and unoxidized, no surface cratering
generic_ic.reliability_note: Visual optical detection cannot verify silicon logic or ROM contents without test jig

logic_ic.name: Digital Logic / Gate IC (74xx / 40xx series)
logic_ic.condition_assumptions: Standard SOIC/DIP package with legible part marking
logic_ic.reliability_note: Commonly recovered for repair work and educational maker kits

power_management_ic.name: Power Management IC (PMIC / Buck-Boost Controller)
power_management_ic.source: Appliance & PC Motherboard Repair Workshop Survey
power_management_ic.condition_assumptions: Thermal pad unseparated, no burn marks around VCC pins
power_management_ic.reliability_note: High demand in board repair shops if intact

eeprom_memory_ic.name: Flash / EEPROM / Serial Memory IC
eeprom_memory_ic.reliability_note: Requires flashing and memory verification before reuse

generic_microcontroller.name: Generic Microcontroller / Embedded SoC
generic_microcontroller.condition_assumptions: Pins or QFN/BGA ball array intact, no silicon package crack
generic_microcontroller.reliability_note: Resale requires firmware clearance and pin continuity test

arm_cortex_mcu.name: 32-bit ARM Cortex / RISC-V MCU
arm_cortex_mcu.reliability_note: Premium value in IoT prototyping and embedded repair markets

8bit_mcu.name: 8-bit Microcontroller (AVR / PIC / 8051 compatible)
8bit_mcu.reliability_note: Consistent utility in domestic consumer appliance controllers

small_signal_transistor.name: Small Signal BJT / Switching Transistor (TO-92 / SOT-23)
small_signal_transistor.condition_assumptions: Three leads intact, no thermal discoloration on casing
small_signal_transistor.reliability_note: Easily tested with multimeter diode function for junction gain

power_mosfet_transistor.name: Power MOSFET / IGBT (TO-220 / DPAK)
power_mosfet_transistor.condition_assumptions: Metal tab undamaged, gate-source oxide intact
power_mosfet_transistor.reliability_note: High secondary recovery value in SMPS and motor driver repairs

power_bjt_transistor.name: Medium/High Power Bipolar Transistor (TO-126 / TO-220)
power_bjt_transistor.reliability_note: Commonly harvested for audio amplifier repairs

electrolytic_capacitor.name: Radial Aluminum Electrolytic Capacitor
electrolytic_capacitor.condition_assumptions: Top vent flat (not bulged), rubber bung seated, no electrolyte leak
electrolytic_capacitor.reliability_note: Subject to ESR and capacitance degradation over operating lifespan

tantalum_capacitor.name: Solid Tantalum SMD Capacitor
tantalum_capacitor.source: Precious / Rare Metal Reclamation & Component Exchange
tantalum_capacitor.reliability_note: Contains critical tantalum metal; high secondary demand

ceramic_smd_capacitor.name: Multi-layer Ceramic SMD Capacitor (MLCC)
ceramic_smd_capacitor.reliability_note: Usually harvested in bulk rather than individual sales

generic_connector.name: Generic Pin Header / Board-to-Board Connector
generic_connector.condition_assumptions: Plastic housing unmelted, pins straight, contact plating intact
generic_connector.reliability_note: Mechanical durability readily verifiable by visual inspection

usb_hdmi_interface.name: External I/O Jack (USB-A/C, HDMI, RJ-45 Ethernet)
usb_hdmi_interface.condition_assumptions: Shielding unbent, interior plastic tongue unbroken, solder lugs clean
usb_hdmi_interface.reliability_note: High utility for consumer electronics repair

terminal_block_header.name: Screw Terminal / Power Jack / Heavy Molex Header
terminal_block_header.reliability_note: Very durable; highly reusable in DIY power projects

generic_resistor.name: SMD / Through-Hole Precision Resistor
generic_resistor.condition_assumptions: End terminations uncracked, resistance within 5% tolerance
generic_resistor.reliability_note: Universal utility in hobbyist repair and maker projects

rectifier_diode.name: General Purpose / Schottky Rectifier Diode
rectifier_diode.condition_assumptions: Glass / plastic case intact, forward drop nominal
rectifier_diode.reliability_note: High utility in power supplies and reverse-polarity protection

indicator_led.name: Surface Mount / 3mm / 5mm Indicator LED
indicator_led.reliability_note: High salvage utility for indicator panels

tactile_switch.name: Tactile Pushbutton / DIP Slide Switch
tactile_switch.condition_assumptions: Mechanical click positive, contact resistance < 1 ohm
tactile_switch.reliability_note: Commonly harvested for consumer remote and appliance repairs

power_inductor.name: Power Inductor / Toroid / Shielded Choke
power_inductor.condition_assumptions: Ferrite core uncracked, copper winding intact
